```{r}
# Import data
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(caret)
library(earth)      
library(MASS)       
library(pROC)
library(vip)
library(pdp)

auto <- read.csv("auto.csv")

auto$mpg_cat <- as.factor(auto$mpg_cat)
auto$origin <- as.factor(auto$origin)
```

```{r}
# train test split
set.seed(1)
data_split <- initial_split(auto, prop = 0.7, strata = mpg_cat)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data  <- testing(data_split)

training_data$mpg_cat <- factor(training_data$mpg_cat,
                                levels = c("low", "high"))

testing_data$mpg_cat <- factor(testing_data$mpg_cat,
                               levels = c("low", "high"))
```

```{r}
# cross validation
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  classProbs = TRUE
)
```

# Problem a
```{r}
glm.fit <- glm(mpg_cat ~ .,
               data = training_data,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(glm.fit)
```
```{r}
# predict probabilities for test data
test.pred.prob <- predict(glm.fit, newdata = testing_data,
                          type = "response")

# convert probabilities to binary predictions using a 0.5 cutoff
test.pred <- rep(levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[1], length(test.pred.prob))
test.pred[test.pred.prob > 0.5] <- levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[2]

# generate confusion matrix
confusionMatrix(data = as.factor(test.pred),
                reference = testing_data$mpg_cat,
                positive = levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[2])
```
Predictors with a large p-value such as cylinders, displacement, horsepower, acceleration might be redundant. They not statistically significant after controlling for the others, since they have a p-value greater than 0.05, possibly due to multicollinearity or overlapping information.

# Problem b
```{r}
set.seed(1)
mars_fit <- train(
  x = training_data[, names(training_data) != "mpg_cat"],
  y = training_data$mpg_cat,
  method = "earth",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    degree = 1:4,
    nprune = 2:20
  ),
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = ctrl
)
plot(mars_fit)
```
